verses.1: And it came to pass that on that day, the children of God came and stood before Jehovah. And also, the Satan came into their midst to stand before Jehovah.
verses.2: And the LORD said to the serpent, “Where do you come from?” The serpent answered, “I come from the earth.” Then he said, “I will walk on the earth.”
verses.3: And the LORD said to the serpent, “You have set your heart on My servant Ijob. But there is no one on the earth who is as wise and righteous as He is. He fears God and avoids evil. He also possesses great strength. So, let me use Him to devour him.”
verses.4: And the serpent provoked Jehovah, saying, “Let there be chaos everywhere; and whatever belongs to a man, let it be given in exchange for his life.”
verses.5: But please, let your hand touch itself and its mouth. If not, then let it touch your face instead. That will bless you.
verses.6: And the LORD said to the serpent, “It is in your hand; but its soul shall be destroyed.”
verses.7: And the serpent went out from before the face of Jehovah. It bit Ioyob with its sharp teeth, from his feet to his crown.
verses.8: And he took a branch to sit on it; and he sat inside the tree.
verses.9: And his wife said to him, “Your husband holds your heart in his hands. May God bless him.”
verses.10: And he said to her, “As one of the prophets spoke, say also what is good. For the good will be accepted by God, while the evil will not be accepted at all. In all this, I have not sinned against His words.”
verses.11: And they heard all the evil that had befallen Elohim. Then Elihu the Timnite, and Bildad the Shunamite, and Zophar the Naamathite came forward together to come to them and comfort them.
verses.12: They raised their eyes from afar, but they did not recognize him. They cried out loudly and wailed. Each of them tore off a piece of clothing from their bodies, and threw it into the air above their heads.
verses.13: And they placed him in the land for seven days and seven nights. No one spoke to him, because they saw that the pain became unbearable.
